native.previewPolicy: Native declarations are preserved without fabricated HTML/CSS equivalents. Component records describe source implementation; they are not browser-renderable previews.

verification.reason: Organizational policy blocked CUA access to local.flightdeck.app. No screenshot or app-control verification performed.

components.name: Release Action
components.description: Native bordered-prominent TestFlight button opens a confirmation dialog; disabled while busy or a job is active.

components.name: Standard Action
components.description: System button for readiness, archive, refresh, reveal, and device actions; native interaction states.

components.name: Destructive Action
components.description: Native destructive Remove action, available for eligible storage rows, followed by path-specific confirmation.

components.name: Worktree Field
components.description: Rounded-border native text field within LabeledContent; placeholder reflects selected project root.

components.name: Workspace Sidebar
components.description: Sidebar List with workspace and project sections, SF Symbols, accent active-section text, and selected-project checkmark.

components.name: Recent Run Row
components.description: Native selectable list row combining status symbol, release mode, caption stage, and fine metadata.

components.name: Run Log
components.description: Selectable monospaced output in a two-axis ScrollView with semantic text background and separator border.

components.name: Device Lease Row
components.description: Inset native list row with device, owner, worktree, optional seed metadata, and explicit lease actions.

components.name: Storage Row
components.description: Native list row with path, eligibility, measured or unknown bytes, Reveal, and eligible-only Remove.

components.name: Feedback Strip
components.description: Dismissible error or notice content with low-opacity semantic status color above the detail surface.

narrative.overview: A compact SwiftUI working interface. System text, alignment, dividers, and explicit state labels establish hierarchy; lists carry operational information.

rules.name: The System Appearance Rule
rules.body: Preserve semantic colors and native appearance adaptation; do not freeze them to a sampled light-mode palette.

dos: Do preserve native system controls and typography.
Do accompany status colors with text or symbols.
Do distinguish source inspection from visual verification.
donts: Don't invent fixed values for dynamic semantic colors or text styles.
Don't add decorative cards or shadows to this established interface.
Don't claim visual QA has passed.
